inspectionType: AI visual inspection of every actual rendered page using the local image viewer.
scope: Table layout, labels, chart axes and legends.
Clipping, overlapping text and unintended empty pages.
Visible treatment of descriptive ranking, unavailable metrics, shared-control counterpoint and reviewer tradeoffs.
nonblockingObservations: Pages 8, 9 and 15 are dense but all text remains visible; small table labels benefit from normal PDF zoom.
Several short section pages leave generous whitespace, but none is an unintended empty page or missing section.

pages.observation: Title, completion status, measured scope table and reading instructions are clear. Human readability remains unevaluated; no total score out of 100 is invented.
Nine-route architecture table is readable. Same-model reviewer dependence, restricted Wren scope, managed-retrieval limits and retained failures are stated.
All nine rows and numeric columns fit. Routes remain in declared order; full benchmark success, errors and score out of 90 are legible.
Success bars, uncertainty whiskers, axis labels and per-family heatmap are readable. Cell denominators are shown; no label collision found.
Cost/success scatter labels and leader lines distinguish the nearby routes. Latency bars and p50/p95 labels fit; harness pacing is disclosed.
Dense 18-row latency table fits without clipping. Complete/partial/unknown/no-call distinctions and N/A values are visible.
Paired-effect intervals and cost/unknown-reservation tables fit. Exploratory-contrast and paid-equivalent cost caveats are readable.
Reviewer error bars and all three methods fit. False acceptance and false rejection are clearly distinguished. The dense lower explanatory text remains within the page.
Managed-search raw-rank metrics remain N/A while selected-document coverage is reported. Failure-condition labels and counts fit; dense footnotes remain readable.
The shared-capability control counterpoint is explicit: R0 leads this small financial/entry subset. Its limited group count and secondary status are clearly stated.
Five fixed-weight score columns, rank ranges and declared weights fit. No human score is imputed and stable rank is not called statistical superiority.
Targeted paired-effect plot has readable labels, intervals, zero line and the +5 percentage-point practical target. The comparison scope is described.
Component decisions and reviewer tradeoff tables fit with clear wrapped target-family cells. Inconclusive and below-practical-target assessments are visible.
Configuration responsibilities and observed tradeoff tables are legible. There is no invented complexity score or claimed production winner.
All 23 limitation items are visible and readable, including prose-faithfulness, synthetic-data, reviewer-correlation and latency limits. The page is dense but not clipped.
Provenance hashes, source explanation and wrapped reproduction command remain visible within the margins. Vector/source provenance and snapshot binding are stated.

limits: This is AI visual inspection, not independent human readability scoring or expert financial review.
The review checks visible presentation; it does not independently recompute study results or establish statistical validity.
